messages:
mina: Heads up — Docusaurus build unhappy on docs-restructure branch (PR #614). Linkcheck shows several fragment misses and a weird case where a snippet starting with an @decorator causes the page to render but link anchors shift. ci-bot: linkcheck: 4 failed fragments - /docs/guides/migrate#python-snippet -> 404 (fragment not found) - /docs/reference/generate#responseformat -> 404 (fragment not found) - /docs/console/limits#tokens-per-route -> 404 (fragment not found) - /docs/snippets/auth#key-usage -> 200 but redirected -> warn oz: Reproduced locally. Docusaurus slugify for headings with punctuation collapses differently than our old mkdocs pipeline. Also noticed MDX treats leading \"@\" in fenced code as import-ish and shifts the AST which can change the generated ids. tara: Quick fixes: add explicit header ids for critical anchors (e.g. `## Response format {#response-format}`) and add `` around snippet includes that start with decorators. That avoids MDX touching the code. mina: Can we add a small pre-commit check or GH Action that runs a fragment-check step after build? I don't want another PR merged that silently breaks links. ci-bot: Suggestion: run `yarn build && npx linkinator ./build --fragment` in PR CI for docs/* changes. devops-bot: Deployed a tiny patch to the docs CI image pinning docusaurus/remark-slug to a known-behaviour version to reduce churn while we fix content. oz: I'll open PR with three changes: explicit ids on the API pages we moved, raw wrappers for tricky snippets, and a redirects map in docusaurus.config.js for the heaviest-hit anchors. tara: I'll update the contributors.md with a short note about stable anchors and include examples: explicit ids, avoid leading punctuation in headings, and prefer explicit language in fences (```python) to be safe. mina: Thanks. Let's re-run linkcheck once PR is up. If anything else pops up we can fall back to inline HTML anchors as a last resort: `

Response format

` oz: Opening WIP now and assigning to @tara for review.
